Source Pre-Pipeline Input Builder Scripts

Source: R/execute.R
sourceInputBuilderScripts.Rd

Auto-discovers and sources builder scripts from pre-pipeline directories in a MANDATORY dependency order. execStudyPipeline and testStudyPipeline call this for each config block, right before generating that block's cohorts, so builders can make database-specific changes; call it directly to build inputs while developing. The order ensures concept sets are available before cohorts, and dependent cohorts can reference already-loaded cohort definitions.

Usage

sourceInputBuilderScripts(
  projectPath = here::here(),
  configBlock = NULL,
  pipelineVersion = "prod",
  verbose = TRUE,
  stopOnError = TRUE
)

Arguments

projectPath

Character. Path to the project root. Defaults to current project.

configBlock

Character vector. Config block name(s) from config.yml. Scripts are sourced once per block, with the current block available as inputBuilderEnv$configBlock. Defaults to NULL (source once).

pipelineVersion

Character. Pipeline version made available to builder scripts as inputBuilderEnv$pipelineVersion. Defaults to "prod", matching createExecutionSettingsFromConfig; pass the test namespace (e.g. "dev") when building inputs for a test run.

verbose

Logical. If TRUE (default), displays which scripts are being sourced.

stopOnError

Logical. If TRUE (default), stop at the first builder script that errors. If FALSE, warn and continue with the remaining scripts.

Value

Invisibly returns a list with:

  • sourced_files: Character vector of sourced files (absolute paths)

  • config_blocks: Character vector of config blocks processed (NULL when configBlock is NULL)

  • directories_checked: Character vector of directories checked

  • error_summary: Named list of error messages from failed scripts (only non-empty when stopOnError = FALSE)

Details

All six scripts are required and are sourced in the following FIXED order:

  1. inputs/conceptSets/R/import_atlas_concept_set.R

  2. inputs/conceptSets/R/import_capr_concept_set.R

  3. inputs/cohorts/R/import_atlas_cohort.R

  4. inputs/cohorts/R/import_capr_cohort.R

  5. inputs/cohorts/R/import_sql_cohort.R

  6. inputs/cohorts/R/build_dependent_cohorts.R

This order is enforced to guarantee dependencies are satisfied:

  • Concept sets load first (may be needed by cohort definitions)

  • Base cohorts load next (may be needed by dependent cohorts)

  • Dependent cohorts load last (can reference base cohorts)

Use makeInputBuilderScript to create scripts with the correct naming convention. The function aborts before sourcing anything if a required script is missing or if inputs/conceptSets/R/ or inputs/cohorts/R/ contain any other .R file, since such a file would otherwise never run. Unused builders should be left in place: the templates run without error when they have not been populated. Put helper code in a subfolder (e.g. inputs/cohorts/R/src/), which is not checked.

When configBlock is supplied, the full set of scripts is sourced once per config block, in order, the same way execStudyPipeline() runs tasks once per database. Before each pass, an inputBuilderEnv object (see createInputBuilderEnv) holding the current config block and the pipeline version is assigned into the global environment, so builder scripts can build execution settings without hard-coding either value, e.g. createExecutionSettingsFromConfig(configBlock = inputBuilderEnv$configBlock, pipelineVersion = inputBuilderEnv$pipelineVersion). When configBlock is NULL, scripts are sourced once with inputBuilderEnv$configBlock set to NULL.

By default, an error inside a builder script stops the run immediately: input building is a hard precondition of pipeline execution, and later builders may depend on earlier ones, so a failed script must stop main.R before execStudyPipeline() can be reached. Set stopOnError = FALSE to instead warn and continue with the remaining scripts; the errors are then returned in error_summary.
